description: Backend API Gateway (Go) - REST API with JWT auth, RBAC, routing, and all endpoint handlers for auth, assets, graph, attack paths, and dashboard. Complete Go service with clean architecture.
steps: Create /backend/api-gateway/go.mod and go.sum with module path github.com/cyberajju/ARES-X/backend/api-gateway and Go 1.21+
Create /backend/api-gateway/main.go with server startup, graceful shutdown, config loading from env vars, structured logging setup
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/config/config.go with configuration struct loading from environment variables (server port, JWT secret, DB URL, service URLs, log level)
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/middleware/auth.go with JWT authentication middleware - token extraction from Authorization header, validation, claims parsing, context injection

Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/middleware/rbac.go with role-based access control middleware - role hierarchy (Admin > Analyst > Operator > Executive > ReadOnly), permission checking per endpoint
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/middleware/logging.go with structured request logging middleware - method, path, status, duration, request ID
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/middleware/cors.go with CORS middleware for frontend communication

Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/models/ with Go structs: user.go (User, Role, Session, Credentials), asset.go (Asset, AssetType, Criticality, AssetFilter), graph.go (GraphNode, GraphEdge, GraphQuery, PathResult), attack_path.go (AttackPath, PathStep, TTP, Simulation), dashboard.go (DashboardStats, Alert, SystemStatus), response.go (ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse, ErrorResponse)
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/handlers/auth.go with handlers: Login (credential validation, JWT generation), Logout (session invalidation), RefreshToken, InitMFA, VerifyMFA
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/handlers/assets.go with handlers: ListAssets (pagination, filtering), GetAsset, CreateAsset, UpdateAsset, DeleteAsset, SearchAssets, BulkImport
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/handlers/graph.go with handlers: QueryNodes, QueryEdges, GetPaths, GetBlastRadius, GetDependencies
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/handlers/attack_paths.go with handlers: ComputeAttackPaths, ListAttackPaths, GetAttackPathDetails, GetPathScore
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/handlers/dashboard.go with handlers: GetDashboardStats, GetAlerts, GetSystemStatus, GetRecentActivity
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/router/router.go setting up all routes with proper middleware chains (public routes for auth, protected routes for everything else, admin-only routes)
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/services/jwt.go with JWT token generation (access + refresh tokens), validation, and claims management using standard library crypto
Create /backend/api-gateway/internal/services/audit.go with audit logging service for security events
acceptance_criteria: Go code compiles with go build (stdlib only, no external deps beyond standard library)
JWT auth middleware properly validates tokens and injects claims into context
All API endpoints have proper request validation and error responses
Structured JSON logging on all requests
verification: Run 'go vet ./...' in /backend/api-gateway/ to verify code correctness
Run 'go build ./...' in /backend/api-gateway/ to verify compilation (stdlib-only code should compile without network)
findings: Go 1.25.1 available at /opt/toolchains/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.25.1/bin/go. Used go1.22 in go.mod since the new ServeMux pattern matching (METHOD /path) and r.PathValue() require Go 1.22+. Both go build ./... and go vet ./... pass with zero external dependencies. All 23 files created implementing the full API gateway.
